field_checks.summary: Readable source paths were confirmed first. Independent XML/PDF review found Table 1 has 9 fermentation-condition groups and Table 2 has 26 numeric inhibition-circle observations plus 10 dash exclusions. Current finals preserve 38 activity records: 26 Table 2 records with Table 1 condition mapping, 3 purified bacteriocin P7 MIC/zone records, and 9 p39/Figure 5 CFS stability records. Figure 3, Figure 4, and Figure 10B/C activity-bearing visual surfaces are represented as explicit unresolved/excluded surfaces rather than promoted as exact rows.

The database layer is source-reviewed but intentionally non-authoritative: authoritative linked article, assay, sequence, and literature rows are all zero, while 5 DBAASP/Codex fallback machine rows have sequence None and no stable database record identity. All 5 final database audits are unresolved_record, source_verified count is 0, and authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false. This is a preserved caution, not a blocker, because fallback rows are not promoted for RC2, portal, or authoritative ingest.

Every current final JSON record was enumerated in the paper final and packet final mirrors. The six current final files are byte-identical across both mirrors. Final counts are 38 activity records, 6 toxicity records, 5 database record audits, 3 mechanism claims, and 0 review rework targets. Live packet ticket state has 12 requests, 12 closure receipts, 0 open tickets; materials_manifest, analysis_status, and the strict acceptance artifact all report open_rework_ticket_count 0.

Mechanism ontology boundaries are preserved. The 3 final mechanism claims are classified as inferred_mechanism, phenotype_supported, and inferred_mechanism. No claim is direct_mechanism and all direct_assay_types arrays are empty. SDS/permeability wording is retained as discussion/inference only, and antimicrobial phenotype evidence is not promoted to molecular mechanism closure.

Primary XML/PDF identity matches PMC11897483: DOI 10.3389/fphar.2025.1530043, PMID 40078294, 2025 Frontiers in Pharmacology title. Entity linkage is separated correctly: B. velezensis G7/CFS fermentation-broth activity is distinct from purified bacteriocin P7 MIC/zone and toxicity records. The p39/Figure 5 records are scoped to CFS, while later purified-bacteriocin records remain at p45, p47, p49, and Figure 10.

Locator and normalization checks passed. XML/PDF source locators in final activity, toxicity, mechanism, and database records resolve exactly or to their source base locator; granular table-cell locators resolve to the Table 2 source surface. Database-only fallback locators resolve to the fallback JSONL file and remain excluded from authoritative source verification. Numeric values retain source units directly; no unsafe mass-to-molar conversion was performed. No object in the inspected final, packet, or work JSON contains both a plain one-letter sequence and sequence_length, so no sequence-length mismatch exists.

Recursive authority and release boundaries are preserved. The current strict acceptance artifact reports authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready false; final database verification has source_verified 0 and unresolved_record 5; activity evidence marks fallback rows as not authoritative and not promoted. This supports paper-level publication-grade curation only, not RC2, portal, or authoritative DBAASP ingest.

No blocking source conflict remains, but preserved cautions are material: fallback DBAASP rows are not authoritative, Figure 3 and Figure 4 activity surfaces are unresolved visual surfaces rather than exact rows, and p57 reports a stricter MIC-2MIC hemolysis threshold than p49 while exact Figure 10A labels are retained separately. These cautions are visible in final review and layer artifacts.

Supplementary surface exhaustion is complete for the staged packet. The paper source supplementary directory and packet raw supplementary_original directory exist and are empty. supplementary_index lists no files, supplementary_text has 0 rows, supplementary_tables has 0 tables, archive_manifest has 0 archives, extraction_errors is empty, and XML has no supplementary-material references. No supplementary sequence, activity/toxicity, or mechanism evidence is available or omitted.

Toxicity/selectivity coverage is source-faithful. Figure 10A exact hemolysis labels are preserved as 0.8193%, 3.7988%, and 10.949% for MIC, 2MIC, and 4MIC. Prose threshold rows preserve p49 less-than-10% at MIC-2MIC and p57 less-than-5% at MIC-2MIC as threshold/caution evidence, not replacements for exact Figure 10A records. Target material is domestic chicken/chicken blood erythrocyte context; unsupported LfcinB, sheep, or lipidation terms are absent.

cautions.summary: All 5 DBAASP/Codex fallback rows remain unresolved and non-authoritative because no linked authoritative sequence, assay, article, or literature records exist; they must remain excluded from RC2, portal, and authoritative ingest.

Figure 3, Figure 4, and Figure 10B/C are activity-bearing visual surfaces but are preserved as unresolved/excluded rather than exact row-level activity values because local text/locator extraction does not safely bind every panel value, unit, target, and condition.

The source contains both p49 less-than-10% hemolysis wording for MIC-2MIC and p57 less-than-5% wording for MIC-2MIC; final toxicity keeps exact Figure 10A labels and preserves both prose thresholds as threshold/caution evidence.
